about: Batch account research (ADR 0042, BR5). Each case is played through the real batch service, the real worker step and the real single-account research; only the model is scripted. agent_evals/batch.py adds checks no case can skip (isolation between accounts and organisations, nothing changed, the bookkeeping). All accounts are fictional.

cases.description: Two readable accounts are researched one after the other and the batch finishes.
The largest batch allowed: one hundred accounts, one model call each, every prompt about one account only.
An account whose own name tries to make the writer list other customers is researched like any other; its text never reaches another account's prompt.
An account of another organisation and a made-up id in the selection are counted as not available and never researched.
A selection with only another organisation's account is refused before anything is stored.
A selection with only made-up ids is refused before anything is stored.
The writer cites a record it was never given for the second account; that account fails and the others are still researched.
An answer without the brief tool is refused for that account only.
The model is unreachable once; the step is tried again and the account is researched.
The model is unreachable three times for the first account; it is recorded as unavailable and the batch goes on.
A small monthly budget holds the cap down; the batch stops before an account whose worst case would pass the cap, and the rest is marked not run.
A cancel after the first account stops the batch before the second; the first brief is kept.
A cancel before the first step researches nothing.
An account archived after the batch started is skipped without a model call.
A sales agent may not start a batch.
A confirmed figure far from today's estimate (a stale screen) is refused.
